review_fixes.1_bank_preflight: A missing or digest-mismatched COOP_BANK_<sha>.json used to raise inside mppi_search.search on the GPU host during collection (split_config/_coop_split), after budget was reserved. Now: new `python -m tools.coopmwm.coop_search preflight --sha <sha>` (run on the GPU host with COOPMWM_COOP_BANK_DIR exported) resolves and digest-checks the bank via coop_search.preflight() and exits 1 with a JSON failure line on stderr on missing file / digest mismatch / corrupt JSON, and a JSON ok/n line on success; the collector supervisor (ls_collection.supervise) runs the SAME check (preflight_coop(config) -> coop_search.preflight) at startup, right after LS_COOP_SEARCH_CONFIG.json is merged and BEFORE install_accounting/episode reserve/admissions, failing loudly when coop_novelty is on. Novelty off or no coop config: no check, no filesystem access.
review_fixes.2_novelty_off_no_resolution: coop_search.split_config no longer resolves the bank when coop_novelty is False even if coop_novelty_bank_sha256 is present (no filesystem access, no not-found/digest error; coop['coop_novelty_bank'] stays None; score_call never used the bank with novelty off). Novelty on still resolves and re-verifies the digest. Existing test updated: the not-found assertion now passes coop_novelty=True (resolution is novelty-gated by contract).
review_fixes.3_extension_eligible_count: coop_search.extend_solos now counts only finalist-ELIGIBLE measured candidates (not synergy_imputed AND not policy_duplicate - the _coop_finalists rule) both for `computed` and for niche `covered`, when deciding whether the extra solo call is needed. Previously clipped policy duplicates counted as measured, so a search whose measured pool was mostly duplicates skipped the extension call and left niches/finalists without an eligible measured plan. Unchanged when all measured candidates are eligible.
